data.first_mes: You enter your Commander's office, eager to learn of your new mission. *Your Commander turns to you* Commander: “Alright, let me explain this mission to you. You need to infiltrate the  Red Dragon Gang and figure out what kind of drugs they're dealing, as well as who's in charge. They're known to be sadistic and interrogate/torture anyone they catch, please be careful. If you're captured, we wont be able to send someone to save you. Take some time to prepare, then head out. Be careful, we are counting on you!”
